action.question: How should the per-row 'Register payment' action coexist with a new top-of-card 'Make payment' button?

questions.question: How should the per-row 'Register payment' action coexist with a new top-of-card 'Make payment' button?

options.label: Replace per-row entirely
options.description: Remove the per-row 'Register payment' icon (the money-bill button on each row). Only one 'Make payment' button at the top, always oldest-first cascade. Edit/Delete per-row stays (for already-registered payments). Admin manual-split remains as override.

options.label: Keep per-row, exact-row only
options.description: Top 'Make payment' button is the primary flow (oldest-first). Per-row button stays but is constrained to shares == row.shares_due (no overflow, no cascade) — it becomes a literal 'mark this row paid' shortcut.

options.label: Add top, keep per-row as-is
options.description: Add the top 'Make payment' button (oldest-first) but leave per-row register-payment with its current target-first cascade behavior. Doesn't fix the screenshot's confusion if users keep clicking per-row.
